lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Starlight. Don’t wanna be late for your first official meeting. I had a whole welcome speech planned.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Homelander is fine.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Hey. C’mon. Stop.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: What’s Starlight gonna think, listening to us haggle over nickels? We’re the Seven for God’s sake. Now what I want to hear -- is who you saved this week. Black Noir, let’s start with you --
Howdy ho, buckaroo.
Well, hand him over to the police. Of course.
Absolutely.
You know, sometimes it feels like the justice system doesn’t even work anymore...
Really, uh, really speaks to the deterioration of, uh, God fearing American values.
Someone should do something.
Oh, no comment...
Oh. Electrical fire. How was your meeting?
You don’t have to apologize. So I’m gonna go run lines with Noir. Scene 43 tonight. Real magilla.
Nothing.
Why would anything be wrong?
Oh, by the way? I went to the Tower. You weren’t there. No one knew where you were.
I was checking to see how your meeting went. But it’s fine.
Explain? Why would you have to explain anything?
So they can tell the world we let everyone else die?
Flap, flap, flap goes that mouth of yours. You told me you don’t break easy. I’ve been thinking about that. A lot.
How old are you?
Is that you with...?
Vought. That’s Frederick Vought.
It’s certainly ambitious.
You’re so humble! She’s amazing. Blows me out of the water. Every take.
Oh, no comment...
Oh, of course. Total diva.
I’ve been with roughly the same crew since Homelander: Origins. We really are a family.
But by making an action plan, you'll dramatically improve your chances of survival -- and your survival is the only thing that matters.
How’s Noir?
Noir’s a vegetable. Lamplighter was a charcoal briquette on our floor. Starlight’s in the wind. And you’re just... fine with all this?
And you didn’t do this?
There’s no Super Villains really on American soil, right?
Then it was Edgar.
Hey, buddy. Sorry we left you all alone. Work’s been crazy.
Don’t wanna play Vought Tournament of Heroes? I’m the main guy.
States?
You’re giving yourself homework?
Yeah. Your mom’s got all kinds of cute little sayings.
Of course you can. STORMFRONT FAN Stormfront, love you. Can I...? HOMELANDER Okay, everybody. One at a time. We just came here to eat.
What’s that, kiddo?
Everyone back away, please. Please back away.
Inside. Wants to be alone.
He doesn’t want to talk to me. I -- I tried.
Don’t be sorry. I’m sorry. I should’ve known that would happen.
I remember the first time I was in a crowd.
Well no, we’re Gods. We don’t feel fear or pain or --
-- I was terrified. All these people staring at me. Reaching out for me, egging me on to show my powers. I felt like I was drowning.
I flew away. They found me 87 miles down I-9. Crying.
Not in a long time, but yes. Maybe next time, you’ll fly away. With me.

Son. I didn’t just wake up one morning and fly out the door. I had to learn. But there was no one to teach me. The doctors kept their distance, they were so scared of me. I was all alone. But you don’t have to be. I can teach you.

Of course. You’re a part of me, we’re a part of each other. I love you. I might not always know what to do -- but we can do it together. Would that be okay? BECCA Anything? BUTCHER I know where he is.
You’ll get it. It helps to imagine someone you hate.
No swear jar here.
So try again, son.
What’s going on?
Never mind. It’s just a --
I don’t know. Stay here.

What the fuck. MOTHER’S MILK Won’t take him long to find all the speakers, we gotta move. What’s wrong? BUTCHER Take my car, get them both to Mallory. Get ‘em both safe. MOTHER'S MILK That ain’t the plan -- BUTCHER Please, you’re the only one I trust with her. BECCA You’re not coming with us?
Did you say “Mr. Butcher?” What is going on?
Where is my son?
WHERE IS MY SON??
Did you do this, Ryan?
Let’s go.
Ryan. I said let’s go. NOW!! LET’S GO NOW!
You’re gonna blow yourself up to save the little shit who murdered your wife?
Have it your way.
The fuck are you doing here?
And why would I --
If you did that, I’d destroy everyone and everything.
Thanks to the heroism of Queen Maeve and Starlight, Stormfront was neutralized. She is now being held in an undisclosed location.
I would like to personally apologize to Starlight, who was falsely accused of conspiracy and sabotage. I know that you and Maeve are two of the most loyal friends I could have.
Thanks to the heroism of Queen Maeve and Starlight, Stormfront was neutralized. She is now being held in an undisclosed location.
I would like to personally apologize to Starlight, who was falsely accused of conspiracy and sabotage. I know that you and Maeve are two of the most loyal friends I could have.

We are supposed to be your heroes. To protect and serve you. For Stormfront to betray your trust, and ours, by corrupting that relationship, is a grievous crime. And I promise you, justice will be served.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: You’re up early. I couldn’t sleep either.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Used to be, The Seven was a circle of trust. The good old days. One for all and all for one. A-Train, I would’ve killed for him. I have killed for him. I’d do the same for any of you, you know that, right?

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Did A-Train say anything? Why -- how -- he could do that to me?

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I wonder how long he was plotting behind my back. Laughing at me, with William Butcher? As if I’m some fucking moron, as if I’m too long in the tooth to bite back.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Fuck all of them. Fucking Sage, Starlight, Maeve, Stillwell -- they all stabbed me in the back. Christ, even my own son is... rebelling. I’m starting to think... maybe I’m the problem. I’m too open. I trust people too much. They mistake my kindness for weakness. Well, no more. I don’t need any of them. And if you want something done right...

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Your predecessor was a good listener, too. He was my favorite, I could tell him anything... but he kept the biggest secret of all.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I wonder what secrets you’re keeping in there? Hmm? Stand up, would you?

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I’ve missed this.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - HOMELANDER'S APARTMENT - DAY
lines.dialogue: God damn it, Ryan...

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - HOMELANDER’S APARTMENT - CONTINUOUS
lines.dialogue: Ryan. Come here.

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - HOMELANDER’S APARTMENT - CONTINUOUS
lines.dialogue: I’m your father, not him. Come here right now. That’s an order, young man!

lines.scene: INT. SEVEN TOWER - HOMELANDER’S APARTMENT - CONTINUOUS
lines.dialogue: Ryan. Ryan!

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: “Ally,” Victoria, really? You’re a bit more than that. It’s time to tell them.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: It’s nothing to be ashamed of, quite the opposite. So tell the truth. Fine, I will. She’s a Superhero.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Secrets rot your soul. You’re unburdened. You should thank me.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Fuck Sage. She’s long gone. We don’t need that arrogant bitch.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: We’re going to change the world, Vicky, for our children, and their children. We freed our race from bondage, they’ll sing our song for centuries. It’s our destiny, yours. The first Super-abled President.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Why would we care?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Says who?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: New world, new rules.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: You think I didn’t think of that? Of course I thought of that. Our fates are connected now, Singer’s as good as dead, and I am the only friend you’ve got. This train has left the station, gorgeous. And you’re on it.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: I need you to make a list. Anyone inside Vought who might have damaging information about me or The Seven, anything that might give them leverage.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Have you seen Ryan?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: No. Boys need space.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Right. Well, you can leave.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: The Seven is a circle of trust. What we’re going to tell you is extremely sensitive. Needless to say, you understand the absolute horror that awaits you if it leaves this room?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Robert Singer will be dead by end of business. Neuman will be sworn in. People will panic. Riots, bloodshed -- someone will need to swoop in and restore order.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Defending the rightful President Neuman and --

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Oh for fuck’s sake, get a Ricola.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: You’re coughing all over me, it’s disgusting. Go sit further down.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Further.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Meanwhile, every employee on this list needs to be... removed by end of day. They all know a little too much about us. Any problems?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Yeah, sure. Good idea.
Victoria...
Failed.
There’s nothing on the news.
We have not failed. I will end Singer myself if I have to.

You will be President, and you will go along with every word I say as if my hand was shoved up your tight puckered asshole, like the puppet you’ve always been. And if you stray an inch off that path, I’ll make sure Zoe feels nothing but pain for the rest of her life, and I’ll send you a piece of her every fucking year for the rest of yours.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: What are you doing here?

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: Have you fucking lobotomized yourself again? Everything turned to shit. The plan is dead --

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: Who is this?

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: To me.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: I broke the deal.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: But... I threw you out like... garbage. Why would you do this?

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: Next time?

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: Hello?
Thank you, Mr. President.

Victoria Neuman was a great American and a dear, dear friend. Murdered in cold blood for being a hero, for being Super-abled. A hate crime, plain and simple, perpetrated by treasonous deep state Starlighters embedded in our own government. This will not stand.

Now that we have full legal authority, a veritable army of Superheroes will be called on to rout these traitors from our government and our streets. We will make America safe, that is my solemn oath to you. And to the Starlighters who would harm this great nation, be warned. Whatever rock you’re hiding under, we’re coming for you. Because as of today, a new age of heroes begins.

lines.scene: EXT. HARBOR - AROUND THE HORN - DAY
lines.dialogue: How long have you known?

lines.scene: EXT. HARBOR - AROUND THE HORN - DAY
lines.dialogue: You’ve gotta be fucking kidding. This whole time?
